description:
Cut the label and filter subprocess tests outside the main query suite to wiring cases, now that the domain owns label and strategic query semantics.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` owns `query_by_label`, `query_by_labels` and `query_strategic`. Subprocess tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph` re-prove them. `label_filter_repeatable_query_tests.rs` (17 tests) proves AND semantics and a single-label regression for each of eight list subcommands. `label_query_json_tests.rs` (7) proves pattern semantics: exact, wildcard, no match and case. `query_json_tests.rs` (5) and the workflows of `label_hierarchy_e2e_test.rs` (4) assert filter membership. `query_json_tests.rs` also holds the guard against a parent filter given before the `query` subcommand, an argument-validation case with no other owner. The label-validation and hierarchy-warning properties of `label_hierarchy_e2e_test.rs` have no other owner.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: These files hold at most one case per list subcommand and per filter flag, each asserting that the filter reaches the domain query. They also keep the invalid-pattern error and the parent-filter guard as argument-validation cases.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each removed case's property has an owning test in `crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` before the case is removed, so no semantic case remains here; the domain owners are added ahead of this change, which adds none itself.
- [hard] REQ-03: The label-validation and hierarchy-warning assertions of `label_hierarchy_e2e_test.rs` remain.
title: Label and filter CLI tests assert one wiring case per subcommand and flag
